Hi, and welcome to my website!

I am a Ph.D. student in the Department of Statistics & Data Science at Carnegie Mellon University. I graduated from Pomona College with a double major in Mathematics and Philosophy in Spring 2024. At Pomona, I conducted statistical genomics and data science ethics pedagogy research with [Jo Hardin](https://hardin47.netlify.app).

Some current projects:

- "Why Do Students Avoid Each Other? Investigating Positive and Negative Network Effects" with [Nynke Niezink](https://www.stat.cmu.edu/~nynke/) and [Eva Jaspers](https://www.uu.nl/staff/EJaspers)

- "Analyzing Students' Statistics Writing Before and After the Emergence of Large Language Models" with [Erin Franke](https://efranke22.github.io), [Gordon Weinberg](https://sites.google.com/andrew.cmu.edu/gordonw/), and [Alex Reinhart](https://www.refsmmat.com)

- Estimating latent variables in text data via multiple measurements with [Eli Ben-Michael](https://ebenmichael.github.io/)

Find out more about my interests and past experiences by browsing this site.
